nodes.title: Note: How this works
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 Director

The LTX Director timeline, wired to **MiniMax H3**.

### Two model paths
The dropdown next to **Delete** on the toolbar picks the conditioning path, and each path needs its **own UNet**:

| Toolbar | UNet to load |
|---|---|
| `Refs OFF (fl2va)` | `minimax_h3_fl2va_*` |
| `Refs ON (ref2va)` | `minimax_h3_ref2va_*` |

This workflow ships with **fl2va** loaded (text to video + optional first/last frame).

### How the timeline maps
- **Text/prompt segments** compile into a storyboard prompt: `[0s-1.5s] shot one…`. That is H3's native notation for timed control.
- **An image at the start** of the window becomes `first_frame`; an image marked as an **end frame** (or one that runs to the end) becomes `last_frame`. H3 anchors keyframes only at those two positions.
- **Images in the middle**, the **reference-video track** and the **audio track** need `Refs ON (ref2va)`; they become `<Picture i>`, `<Video k>` and `<Audio j>`.
- **Character slots** `@char1..@char3` become `<Picture i>` in ref2va, or their VLM description in fl2va.

### Length and canvas
Length snaps up to H3's **17k+5 frame grid at 24 fps** — 5 s becomes 124 frames (5.17 s). The native canvas is a 768 px short edge capped at 768×1344.

### Audio
H3 generates stereo audio **jointly** with the video, so there is nothing to inpaint. The sampler's single latent feeds both decoders. If you want your own music instead, wire the Director's `combined_audio` into `CreateVideo`.

### Preview
**MiniMax H3 Preview Override** sits between the Director and the sampler. ComfyUI's built-in preview only ever draws the *first* latent frame — this streams the whole shot while it denoises, so you see cuts, motion and timing from the first steps. Needs ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite for the player. Bypass it (Ctrl+B) if you want the plain single-frame preview back.

### Prompt output
The `prompt` output returns the exact storyboard text that was encoded — connect a preview node to it when a shot is not landing.

### Enhance Prompt
The two **Load Image** nodes point at files that only exist on the machine this example was built on — pick your own references there. Sockets on the Enhance node grow as you connect, up to nine.

It needs a **vision** model on Ollama / LM Studio / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; a text-only model ignores the images without saying so. Leave `base_url` empty for the provider default.

`prompt` goes to the Director's `global_prompt`, `ref_images` to its `ref_images`, and `duration_seconds` to its **`duration`** input — the connection-only one, so the length is typed once.

nodes.title: Note: Models & sampling
widgets_values:
## Models

```
📂 ComfyUI/models/
├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   ├── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_*.safetensors
│   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_*.safetensors
├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
└── 📂 vae/
    ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
    └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
```

[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**CLIPLoader type must be `minimax`.**

Sampling: `res_multistep` + `simple` at ~20 steps, through `BasicGuider` (no CFG). For reference-heavy ref2va prompts, `beta` or `normal` often beats `simple`.

Sigma shift lives in the Director's gear menu (video 12.0 / audio 3.0 are the H3 defaults) and is applied to the `model` output.

3 scene in 10 secondi, una per still, in ordine:
alle 00:00 (S1) è nel salotto della villa al tramonto — luce dorata calda dalla vetrata, in piedi accanto alla finestra, sguardo sereno e composto; la scena si apre esattamente sulla still 1
alle 00:04 (S1) cammina lungo il colonnato del giardino al mattino — luce fredda netta, passo deciso, vento leggero sui capelli lunghi; taglio di scena netto
alle 00:08 (S1) di notte in un interno — luce lunare blu dal finestrone, primo piano, sguardo determinato, tensione solenne prima della rivelazione
Luce cinematica, identità di (S1) identica in tutte le scene, atmosfera aristocratica e sospesa. Niente dialoghi.
